Mapped roads and buildings from OpenStreetMap contributors. Terrain from Copernicus DEM GLO-30. One world unit equals one metre.

A stylised prototype. The harbour includes mapped piers, field walls and parking areas. Roofs, windows, wall heights and pier elevations are approximate. Unclassified building footprints are hidden pending verification. Mapped ruins appear as low walls; sheds and garages use smaller models. Building footprints are mapped, but most heights and scenery are estimates. Surface elevations are about 30 m resolution; small road bumps and cambers are not captured. Boundary collisions and simple driving physics are included.
